claims.evidence: Witness photos show an industrial sewing machine head/bed and needle area, but do not show stitch-type confirmation (e.g., stitch selector, stitch sample, or label stating straight-stitch only).
Brand name appears to be 'emel' on the head, but the photos provided do not show a clear country-of-origin marking.
No test-run video/audio or stitch test is shown; photos only show the machine externally.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual are included
claims.evidence: Photos do not show included accessories (foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, attachments) or the manual.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service/maintenance records or internal condition evidence is shown; only external views are reported.

risks.risk: Not actually straight-stitch only (could be multi-purpose or different stitch capability), affecting suitability and value.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine stitching a straight seam and/or a clear label/spec sheet showing stitch type (or stitch selector position) on the head.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an industrial sewing machine with unknown stitch capability (worst-case: not confirmed straight-stitch only).

risks.risk: Does not power on correctly or motor/drive has issues (belt/pulleys, wiring, belt tension).
risks.proof: Test-run clip showing power-on, belt/drive movement, stable handwheel motion, and continuous stitching for a few minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested/unknown working condition.

risks.risk: Worn or damaged needle/presser foot/feed dog causing poor feeding or skipped stitches.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of needle, presser foot, and feed dog teeth + a stitch test showing even feed on fabric.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing possible servicing/parts (worst-case: feed/needle area worn).

risks.risk: Missing key accessories (foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, attachments) reducing usability.
risks.proof: Photo inventory laid out on a surface showing each accessory and the manual (or a clear photo of the manual cover).

risks.risk: Rust, cracks, oil leaks, or internal wear not visible in the provided angles.
risks.proof: Photos of underside/base, belt area, and any openings (plus a wipe/inspection showing no oil leaks) and a short run under load.

risks.risk: Exact model/serial not readable; brand 'emel' may not match the seller’s origin claim and affects parts availability.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of model plate/serial number (or a photo taken straight-on so text is readable).
risks.if_unproven: Price with parts-availability uncertainty (worst-case: model unknown).

proof_requests: Send a short video of the machine powering on and stitching (straight seam) for at least 1–2 minutes.
Provide clear photos of the needle, presser foot, and feed dog (close and well-lit).
Show a photo inventory of all accessories included: foot pedal, power cable, bobbins, needles, and any attachments.
Send a clear, readable photo of the model/serial plate on the head/table area.
Show underside/belt/drive area close-ups (belt condition, pulleys, wiring) and confirm no oil leaks/rust damage.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an industrial sewing machine, but key value-determining facts (working test, stitch capability, accessory completeness, and exact model/condition details) are not proven by the provided images. Without a test run and readable model/accessory proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
